status: no blank left (test_assignment, unity_files_and_guard and acceptance_criteria filled 2026-11-13 by Nusrat in Anisha's absence (Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 13; AUDIT.md section 15); B7 and B11 confirmed by Anisha on 2026-11-13, B11 updated the same day; final setting unseen_look renamed zoom_on_repeat on 2026-11-13); not frozen until Nusrat runs freeze_v4.py --freeze by hand (agreed with Anisha 2026-11-13)
blanks_note: Numbers are chosen by Anisha, not by the code, and not from final results. freeze_v4.py refuses to freeze while a null below or a placeholder name in data_splits.json is left.
decided: 2026-10-24, by Anisha, before any v4 development or final data existed.
final_seed_note: Seed 2 gave the same goal order as the v3 Task 2 final on the v3 map (E1 E2 E4 E2 E1 E3 E4 E1 E4 E1). Since 2026-11-12 (P7, Nusrat during Anisha's absence; AUDIT.md section 15) v4 runs on its own map configs/v4/roadmap.json with six endpoints, so the final goal order is hri_trials.goal_order(2, [E1..E6], 20) = E5 E1 E5 E2 E5 E3 E5 E3 E4 E3 E5 E3 E5 E6 E2 E5 E3 E1 E4 E2, no longer the v3 goals: RQ1 compares different routes (a declared difference). The development seed is 1, as in v3.
timeout_s_source: Set 2026-11-12 by the rule declared before the session (P7; unity/.../Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 6): timeout_s = ceil_to_10(1.5 * L_max / v_run + wait_timeout_s), never below 240 s, with L_max = 65.0 m (the longest v4 route), v_run = 0.3944 m/s (median over the 19 successful runs of the Stage C development session trials_development_Task2_20261112_163710 + bridge_guide_20261112_163011 of road length / run duration) and wait_timeout_s = 20 s: 1.5 * 65.0 / 0.3944 + 20 = 267.2 -> 270 s. Was the v3 value 240 s (configs/trials.json), which fitted the shorter v3 route.
success_radius_m_source: the v3 success radius (same two files)
machine: Nusrat's Windows PC with the NVIDIA RTX 3060, the same machine as the v3 Task 1 final (AUDIT.md section 10)
threshold_rule: Each initial threshold is set on DEVELOPMENT data as the value with the highest development accuracy among those with coverage >= 0.8; ties go to the v3 value, or else to the more conservative value (the one that answers less often, rejects more). Decided 2026-10-24.

zoom_on.note: Zoom rule on; test looks and clips only.

zoom_off.note: Same runs as zoom_on with the zoom rule off (research question 3).

bystanders.note: Several people at each junction, one commander (research question 2).

zoom_on_repeat.note: A REPEAT of zoom_on since 2026-11-13 (B7 = plan (b): every final uses the test look sunbox_f2, never seen in development); named unseen_look until its rename on 2026-11-13 (AUDIT.md section 15). Research question 4 is answered by comparing the finals with the development results.

settings_note: null = not constrained by the setting. Every final session must lie wholly in the test split (data_splits_v4.guard_run with --final-evaluation); a setting's own constraints are checked on top. Which setting uses which test looks and clips is part of the plan: fill the setting notes in AUDIT.md section 14.
run_once: Each setting is run once. A setting with a FINAL_DONE.json in its evaluation folder or in a bridge run folder cannot be started or evaluated again (final_guard_v4.py).
test_assignment_note: B7 = plan (b), decided by Nusrat on 2026-11-13 in Anisha's absence and confirmed by Anisha on 2026-11-13 (Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 13; AUDIT.md section 15): every final uses the test look sunbox_f2 with the test clips of the direction scenario (POINT point_mixamo_02, PROCEED proceed_ik_03), the only plan data_splits_v4.guard_run accepts unchanged for all four settings. zoom_on_repeat (named unseen_look until 2026-11-13) is a REPEAT of zoom_on (same configs, a second session: a repeatability measure); the unseen-look question (RQ4) is answered by comparing the finals with the development results (sunbox_m1, sunbox_f1). In bystanders every person wears sunbox_f2, so the commander is told apart only by behaviour.

unity_files_and_guard.guard: FinalGuardV4 in TrialRunnerV4 (TrialPlayV4 -finalSetting NAME): refuses an unknown setting, a blank here, an unfrozen frozen.json, a listed Unity file missing, unrecorded or changed, the development override trials.local.json, and a setting already run (UNITY_FINAL_DONE.json or FINAL_RUN_DONE.json)

unity_files_and_guard_note: B9, decided by Nusrat on 2026-11-13 in Anisha's absence, PENDING HER CONFIRMATION (Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 13; AUDIT.md section 15). freeze_v4.py records the LF-normalised SHA-256 of every file of freeze_list (its freeze_files) under unity_files in frozen.json; its checks and the Unity guard compare them.
acceptance_criteria: leak test passed in Unity (session.json leak_test.passed) and in Python (gt_path.py session)
frozen hashes match: freeze_v4.require_frozen passes after the session (frozen.json frozen; every v4 config, v3 file v4 reads, B9 Unity file and model file matching its recorded hash)
split guard passed: the looks and clips of every run (run_###/truth.jsonl) pass data_splits_v4.guard_run with final_evaluation (test split only, no mix, no unlisted name)
all runs present: runs_per_setting runs numbered 1 to runs_per_setting, each with one results_unity.csv row, one run_### folder and one python_trial_###.json
every outcome recorded: summary_unity.json and UNITY_FINAL_DONE.json in the Unity folder; FINAL_RUN_DONE.json and summary.json in the bridge folder
every truth and run file accepted: gesture_data.py for every run_###/truth.jsonl, gt_path.py run for every run folder
run protocol recorded: bridge run_info.json machine state and resources.csv, plus the free memory and programs running before the session
acceptance_criteria_note: B11 = validity only: decided by Nusrat on 2026-11-13 in Anisha's absence, confirmed by Anisha on 2026-11-13 and updated the same day before the freeze (AUDIT.md section 15): (a) a watchdog stop is a RESULT, counted as a stop of that run (or as its failure when the run fails), never a reason for invalidity (the earlier criterion 'no watchdog stop after start-up' is removed); (b) frozen hashes match, split guard passed and all runs present are added; (c) a setting that fails a criterion is reported as invalid with the reason and is never rerun. No performance thresholds: results are reported whatever they are, with coverage and intervals. finals_v4/check_session_v4.ps1 checks these criteria.
